“ I will sacrifice myself to the will of our dance! „ ~ Yomi Yomi is a character from the Senran Kagura series. She debuts in Senran Kagura: Portrait of Girls as a secondary antagonist, but later on would become a heroine and supporting character.

She is a Shinobi who is a part of Homura's Crimson Ninja Squad, and formerly a student of Hebijo Academy.

She is voiced by Ai Kayano in the Japanese version, and by Trina Nishimura in the English version.


Appearance[]

Yomi has fair-skin with long blonde hair. Her Shinobi outfit resembles that of a maid, contracting to her backstory. It is a teal-green dress with a white slip underneath it, and a white apron with a shuriken symbol, being held up by a brown belt with a brown bag on the right and a smaller purple bag on the left and a strip of darts for her crossbow. A very large white bow is attached to the back of her dress. The top is colored white stopping at the bustline with frills on the end, her white color also has frills, along with the end of her white gloves, and her arms have greenish-teal armbands with white frills, small white lines resembling a cross and black ribbons. She has long brown boots with black lases, and white stockings underneath them. And she has a teal beret with white lines, along with a large white bow on the back.

She also once weres the Hebijo Academy outfit. But after defecting from it and becoming a renegade, she wears a green sprinters outfit with white lines.

No matter what outfit Yomi weres, she always has a green clip in her front hair.

Personality[]

Yomi presents herself as a polite and well-mannered individual. While she shows herself in this demeanor to her friends, she also known to be savage, aggressive and pretentious against her enemies, constantly taunting them. (especially those born in luxury.)

Due to her growing up in the slums in poverty, Yomi bears an intense hatred and jealousy to people born into the rich, seeing them as people who don't know what it's like to live in hardships. She would see and sense someone with a hint of luxury and began to detest them for it. Though she has learned to see some people that are more than just what she hates. Yomi does has a caring and motherly figure when comes to taking care of her friends, she would cook, clean and tend to them as if they were a part of her family.

She also has huge obsession and appreciation with bean sprouts. She would grow them with grass life in her garden and use them for ingredients for the dishes she makes.
